Multi-channel pump · SP6500-MC Syringe pump · SP6500-S Clinician-out-of-the-loop dosing
!
Misnomer correction
“Closed-loop” in early literature refers only to the pump’s internal flow-rate controller — not autonomous dosing. The prescriber loop stays open: clinicians authorize each dose; the pump enforces the boundary.
